[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Jolee Bindo]] possessed a '''lightsaber''' that originally included a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] that produced a [[Color/Legends|green]] blade, but later included a [[Color/Legends|blue]] one.

==Behind the scenes==
Jolee's lightsaber was first created for ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. In-game, it shared the same hilt as [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]'s [[Fallen Revan's Lightsaber|lightsaber]], as did every other. In ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', it was obtainable on [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]], but it has since been retired and is no longer obtainable.
